note.note:
I cannot generate the requested Problem List Clinical Note without the actual content of the transcript and the differential diagnosis (DDx) JSON. Please provide:

- Transcript: paste the full doctor–patient conversation text.
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx): paste the JSON or structured list exactly as provided.

Notes to help you provide data correctly:
- Include all presenting complaints, onset, duration, progression, pertinent positive/negative history, social history, medications, allergies, and any physical exam findings mentioned.
- Include the DDx items and any stated likelihoods or reasoning if given.
- If any medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, include the name and note that dose/route/frequency is not documented.

Once you provide the transcript and DDx, I will produce:
- Consult Summary: two-line summary.
- Problem List with up to three issues, each including description, timeline, pertinent findings, and, if consistent with the transcript, differential diagnoses from the DDx with brief likelihood tags and justification.
- Medications, Allergies, Past Medical History, Social History, Preventative History, Physical Examination, Plan, and a Document Quality section with required checks.
